name: King's College London
description: King's College London, founded in 1829, is a public research university in central London and a founding college of the University of London. It is a member of the Russell Group and has large health, law and social science faculties.
whyIncluded: King's College London is among the 10 universities in the United Kingdom most chosen by international students (15,690 non-UK students in 2024-25, including 505 from Singapore, per HESA), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: King's College London's own average monthly living costs for 2026-27 in London, over a 9-month undergraduate year. Excludes tuition, flights and visa costs.
livingCosts.notes: King's 'Living expenses' page (2026-27): accommodation £1,164, food £167, travel (zones 1-4) £173, personal and leisure £266, total £1,770 a month; undergraduate 9-month average £15,930 (range £11,979 to £21,078); postgraduate 12-month average £21,240. Average figures used.

programmes.name: Electronic Engineering BEng
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2027, as listed by a course directory (King's own page could not be read). King's may raise fees by up to 7% a year for continuing students.
programmes.notes: Secondary source: King's undergraduate course pages and their /fees subpages load fees by JavaScript, and no official undergraduate fee table or PDF could be found (checked 2026-10-07: kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/tuition-fees says fees are only on each course page; the UCAS entry lists the UK fee only; the returning-student fee page is an interactive form). Figure read from the Studyportals (Bachelorsportal) listing for King's College London, start date 27 September 2027, '38300 GBP / year'. Replace with the official figure when it can be read. King's states (Student Services article KA-02161) that fees for continuing international undergraduate and postgraduate taught students will not rise by more than 7% on the previous year for the same course, so fees are not fixed for the cohort: cohortLocked false. No compulsory fees besides tuition.
